evf.settings.pair_hint: Create the dedicated "(G2)" user for a player and show the QR to scan with the Even Realities App.
evf.pair.title: EvenFoundryVTT · G2 glasses
evf.pair.single_use: and is valid for a single pairing.
evf.pair.expired: The QR has expired and its credentials were rotated. Generate a new QR.
evf.pair.idle_hint: Pick the player and the character, then press «Generate QR». The player scans it with the Even Realities App — nothing to type.
evf.pair.manual_hint: No camera? On the glasses page pick the «(G2)» user and type this code.
evf.pair.check.heading: Connection checks
evf.pair.check.https_fix: Foundry is not served over HTTPS: the Even Realities App will not load the glasses app. Put Foundry behind a valid certificate (reverse proxy, Tailscale or native TLS).
evf.pair.check.publicHost_fix: You opened Foundry from localhost: the QR would point the phone at itself. Reopen Foundry from the address the phone uses, then generate the QR.
evf.pair.check.served_fix: The glasses app is not reachable under /modules/evenfoundryvtt/g2/. Make sure the module is installed and enabled, and that your proxy forwards /modules.
evf.pair.check.socket_fix: The Foundry socket is disconnected. Reload Foundry; behind a proxy, make sure the WebSocket upgrade is forwarded.
evf.pair.devices.heading: Paired devices
evf.pair.revoke.confirm: Revoke this device? The "(G2)" user will be deleted.
evf.pair.error.select: Pick a player and a character first.
evf.pair.error.pair: Pairing failed — see the browser console.
evf.pair.error.expire: Could not invalidate the expired QR — revoke the device to be safe.
evf.pair.error.revoke: Revocation failed — see the browser console.
evf.pair.error.clipboard: Clipboard not available — copy the code by hand.
evf.pair.connected.title: Glasses connected
evf.pair.connected.body: the glasses are receiving the session. The QR has been used and its credentials rotated.
evf.settings.pair_self_hint: Show the QR for your own G2 glasses (after the GM enabled glasses for you). No GM needed.
evf.pair.self.title: EvenFoundryVTT · My G2 glasses
evf.pair.self.not_enabled: The GM has not enabled glasses for you yet: ask them to use «Enable glasses for players».
evf.pair.self.password_pending: Your glasses access is waiting for the GM's browser: keep Foundry open, it is delivered automatically as soon as a GM is connected.
evf.pair.self.no_actor: You do not own a character to show on the glasses.
evf.pair.self.idle_hint: Pick your character, then press «Generate QR» and scan it with the Even Realities App. The glasses answer from your browser while you are online, from the GM's otherwise.
evf.pair.enable.heading: Players' glasses
evf.pair.enable.hint: One-time step: creates the «(G2)» user of each player and delivers its password encrypted to their browser. Then every player pairs their own glasses from «Pair my glasses».
evf.pair.enable.waiting: waiting for the player to open Foundry
evf.pair.enable.regenerated: New password delivered: the player must pair their glasses again.
evf.pair.behalf.heading: Pair on behalf of a player (no Foundry on their side)
evf.pair.error.enable: Could not enable glasses for every player — see the browser console.
evf.pair.error.regenerate: Password regeneration failed — see the browser console.
